Name: Flying Pig Grooming One High Velocity Dog Grooming Dryer, Yellow/Black Logo
Description: The Flying Pig Grooming One High Velocity Dog Grooming Dryer is the ultimate tool for pet parents looking for a fast and comfortable grooming experience for their furry friend. With a high-performance motor, this dryer delivers a strong yet gentle airflow that quickly dries your dog’s coat without causing any discomfort or stress. Customizable heat and variable speed settings give you complete control over the drying process, allowing you to adjust the temperature and airflow according to your pet’s size, coat type, and sensitivity. Designed with professional-grade performance in mind, its robust motor delivers consistent, high-powered airflow that can withstand daily use. Compact and user-friendly, its lightweight design and easy-to-use controls make grooming a breeze. It also comes with a flexible hose, flat nozzle, round nozzle, and an extra filter for added convenience. Say goodbye to soggy towels and long drying times. With this dog grooming dryer, you’ll enjoy a quicker, more comfortable grooming routine and a happier, healthier-looking pet.
